title: The Trifid Nebula

geometryEvidence.reference: A picture of the sky: the plane is the picture's own tangent plane, perpendicular to the sight line through the picture's centre, so it faces the Sun. That centre is 81.6 arcsec from the nebula's position, which is the whole of the recipe's inclination. Not a measured orientation of the nebula.

registration.method: The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.3426 arcsec per pixel, north 0.2° left of vertical, the window's centre at 270.5770458°, -23.0163803°. Not measured against Gaia here.

displayModel: The picture lies on one flat plane facing the Sun at the nebula's distance. Nothing in the picture has depth: seen from the side it is a line.
coverage: The published frame inside a circle: the picture fades out between 70% and 98% of half its short side, so its corners are not drawn and no straight edge shows. Its stars are removed before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it.

acquisition.operation: packages/bake/authoring/far-destinations/picture-source.mts: download the publisher's JPEG (2432 x 4000 px) and cut the window 0, 1568, 2432, 2432 (x, y, width, height), a square on the nebula, without resampling; JPEG quality 95.
